asked.item: Is there an approval link to send to client
How to hold one post back for edits

verdict.reason: S2 says no approval link exists in the web app, and S5-S8 explain how to pause a scheduled post for edits.

steps.text: Blotato does not have a built-in approval-link feature in the web app.
Create your post and schedule it for a future time, then review it in Posts > Scheduled.
To pause a post for edits, open the three-dot menu and choose Move to Drafts, then publish or reschedule once you are satisfied.
